headline.purpose: Inherited section headings; component-specific responsive sizes remain in CSS.

title.purpose: The Pharxmaco name in the Work summary.

body.purpose: The page's DM Sans base; components retain their specific reading sizes.

label.purpose: The uppercase team-project period and status line.

accent.purpose: Georgia accent words in existing headings.

code.purpose: Selectable plain-text credentials; grows on mobile.

about-display.purpose: The two-line introduction: Manrope greeting and lavender italic Georgia role; sizes reduce at 1000px and 600px.

about-biography.purpose: The larger opening profile paragraphs, bounded at 68ch and reduced through 1250px, 1000px, and 600px.

education-title.purpose: The two-line degree name above its school, distinct from the three academic fact values and labels.

shadows.name: preview-selected-navigation
shadows.purpose: Selected item inside the static software illustration.

motion.name: lavender-fill-sweep
motion.purpose: Header and résumé hover/focus fill reveal; the About résumé starts with a solid local lavender fill.

motion.name: work-screen-enter
motion.purpose: Active chapter enters from 14px below, opacity .45, and a bottom 8% clip. Disabled for paused or reduced motion.

motion.name: work-chapter-rule
motion.purpose: Selected chapter rule expands from the left.

motion.name: about-heading-reveal
motion.purpose: The greeting lines slide once from 110% through their masks. Shared reveal cleanup cancels active animations on keyboard focus, pause, or hidden document.

motion.name: about-education-draw
motion.purpose: The active desktop education rule or compact fact-row rule draws once from the left, with measured marker delays and a current-year count. Disabled for paused or reduced motion.

motion.name: inherited-availability-pulse
motion.purpose: Existing availability-dot status pulse while motion is playing; inherited pause/reduced-motion overrides stop it. The About current-year marker and orbital accents also repeat under their own motion rules.

components.name: About introduction
components.description: The large direct greeting with a second lavender italic role line; no decorative eyebrow.

narrative.overview:
The portfolio uses a continuous midnight navy setting with lavender light, large sans-serif headings, and occasional italic serif words. The existing hero, intro, navigation, starfield, and footer establish this identity; the editorial About introduction and Work walkthrough extend it.

Broad section spacing surrounds more compact evidence and interface detail. Hiring teams are the primary audience and instructors the secondary audience, so project status, individual contribution, actions, and clearly labeled illustrative previews remain readable within the cinematic setting.
keyCharacteristics: Midnight navy surfaces with lavender emphasis.
Manrope headings, DM Sans body text, and Georgia italic accents.
Thin cool borders, rounded software surfaces, and restrained ambient depth.
Motion has paused and reduced-motion alternatives.

rules.name: The Incumbent Identity Rule
rules.body: Extend the existing navy, lavender, typography, and atmospheric effects when adding to this portfolio.

rules.name: The Content Boundary Rule
rules.body: Keep ambient stars, light, and gradients behind readable content; preserve the opaque software preview surface.

dos: Do use the existing font stacks and navy/lavender tokens before introducing a new visual treatment.
Do preserve visible keyboard focus and responsive access to every action.
Do keep the Work preview labeled as an illustration using sample data.
Do retain the openly visible cashier username and password in the Work summary: cashier / cashier123.
Do keep motion pause and reduced-motion behavior distinct where the existing layout depends on it.
donts: Don't apply the Work walkthrough composition to unrelated sections as a global template.
Don't turn the illustrative app controls into transaction actions or present them as real application screenshots.
Don't remove the inherited hero, intro, About, or footer identity while extending Work.
Don't make access to project evidence depend on a pinned scroll sequence.
